textNodes.text: I kept rewriting the same easing curves from memory on every project. So I put the ones I trust on one page.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Every curve plays on a small card, with the exact values ready to copy for CSS, Framer and Swift.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: A Framer site with one component per curve. The cards are driven by a single data list, so adding a new curve is one line, and the copy button formats it for the tool you pick.
